why_this_method.value: Scalar visibility averages used to find line-free channels in chemically rich Orion

evidence.quote: a challenging task for a chemically rich region such as Orion

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Electron-neutral (H-) free-free rejected above ~200 GHz as needing implausible disk mass or temperature

evidence.quote: electron-neutral free-free emission cannot be a significant source of opacity at frequencies higher than $\sim$200 GHz.

limitations_admitted.value: Minor axis poorly constrained since source is narrower than beams; centroid method idealized

evidence.quote: SrcI is considerably narrower than the synthesized beams, so our measurements of the minor axis are particularly uncertain.
Of course the model is highly idealized

referee_caveats_inferred: Rotation-curve mass fit is by-eye with idealized edge-on ring; no formal uncertainties
Disk mass strongly depends on assumed opacity and gas-to-dust ratio
Minor axis deconvolved size differs by factor ~2 among methods
Snapshot data with poor short-spacing coverage
